scope: Untimed interval analysis of every saved final shaped overlap-B trial. Run counts are retained per reader. Full wall remains primary. Transfer-body intervals are server observations, not a directly instrumented link-utilization counter.
queue_wait_limit: Worker-side rendezvous wait is not separately instrumented. Consumer sink_seconds measures callback work and does not measure that wait. No exact CPU-versus-queue attribution is claimed.
worker_time_limit: Read/decode and retrieval are sums of overlapping worker elapsed times, not process CPU time or additive wall phases.
causal_fraction_limit: Fewer metadata GETs remove the recorded injected per-request service time in aggregate; request overlap prevents treating that sum as an additive wall saving or causal fraction of the observed gain.

optimized_source_handoff_gap_proxy_secon.scope: Observed timestamp difference from source i final payload response end to source i+2 first payload request start. Includes decode/delivery, validation/open and scheduling; not an isolated queue-wait measurement.
